status_note: filed [ibis#12124](https://github.com/ibis-project/ibis/issues/12124) (open); fixed on Ibis main by [#12104](https://github.com/ibis-project/ibis/pull/12104) (f73d329, 2026-11-02), not released. Reproduces with sqlglot 30.29.0 and Ibis 12.0.0.
summary: From 30.18, `Drop` reads its names from `expressions`, and one given as `this` is not written. Ibis 12.0.0 passes `this`, so its DuckDB `create_table`, which drops a temporary view, fails. Ibis 12 allows any `sqlglot>=23.4`.
repro: `sge.Drop(kind="VIEW", this="t", exists=True).sql("duckdb")` is `DROP VIEW IF EXISTS` (30.17: `DROP VIEW IF EXISTS t`); `ibis.duckdb.connect().create_table("x", pa.table({"a": [1]}))` fails with DuckDB's "syntax error at or near EXISTS".
handling: sverify requires `sqlglot~=30.17.0` (#442). Development stays on 30.22 for fakesnow (`[tool.uv] override-dependencies`), the wheel's tests run 30.17, and the lift reads both versions' GROUP BY. File with Ibis.
